enemies.grid_notes: The Corpse-Eater at the maw's lip — not a foe to kill but a seat to take; script-driven, it does not die, it is climbed into (the become_successor act). No one kills the hunger.
Full-strength einheri; leaps the shifting drops the living cannot (C-DEATH-02). Consumable toward einherjar_consumed>=5 if the count is short.
Second full einheri; the dead do not fall to the map's collapses — every rearranged cliff is a door they walk through.
Rune-lit dead caster feeding the tree's rearrangement; downing it slows the digest for a turn (see digest_slows trigger).

neutrals.grid_notes: SALGERD at the last door — she cannot leave and cannot be answered; the first hope Grim betrays here. Present as the petition being perverted, not a removable unit. No escape_edge: even Hel starves; there is no exit under the roots.

objectives.primary: Reach the maw at [8,8] and take the seat — climb into the hunger (the become_successor act).
secondary: Consume any remaining einherjar needed to reach einherjar_consumed>=5, if that count is not already met before this map.
objectives.defeat: Grim falls into the maw as food rather than heir — the tree wins; no successor.

triggers.note: The rearrange engine wakes: each turn a scripted tile-set migrates — terrain type and elevation shift, the corpse_road/grave_goods overlays travel with them, and the funnel toward the maw redraws. Downed units slide one tile rootward (downhill toward [8,8]) per tick.

Redraw #1: the crest ring (elev 6 at Chebyshev-3 from center) drops to 4 along the west arc (col 4, rows 4-11) while marsh climbs cols 5-6; the western vantage the player just claimed becomes gullet. No lane held from turn 1 survives.

Redraw #2: the whole funnel steps inward one tile — every elevation ring migrates one cell toward center, the 0h maw grows from the 2x2 core to the 4x4 (cols 6-9, rows 6-9), and rows that were 2h terrace become 0h gullet. The map is eating the standing room.
Redraw #3: the maw opens to 6x6 (cols 5-10, rows 5-10) at 0h; only the outermost two rings remain as footing, and they are shrinking. The geometry is now almost all mouth.
Felling the rune-lit caster (e4) freezes the rearrange engine for one turn — the single window to cross ground that will still be there next tick.
A downed player unit slides one tile downhill toward the maw each tick and is consumed if it reaches a 0h gullet tile — the map finishes what the enemy started.

If consume_rite_known (narrative gate, set upstream), striking down this einheri may be a CONSUME (einherjar_consumed += 1) rather than an unhook — the last place to reach >=5 if short. The alignment-ledger resolution script owns the actual write; set_flag_value is the counter delta on a consume.
This map is reachable ONLY with corpse_road_door_found=true and the Successor gate otherwise met (True mercy<=-40, man_blood<=-40, >=5 consumed); it replaces ch4-06 on the secret path.
Reaching the maw's lip offers the become_successor choice; sets final_choice=become_successor and tears the frame fully open — the recitation is happening on the last night of the world (C-FRAME-03).

designer_notes.height_gimmick: The GEOMETRY REARRANGES between turns: terrain type and elevation migrate every round as the map is digested around the player — a tile is ground only until the tree decides it is a mouthful, so there is no holdable high ground, no stable lane, and the funnel toward the maw redraws itself each turn. Elevation is a live crater (0h maw core, 6h crest ring, sloping to a 2h rim) whose every ring steps inward on the turn>=2/4/6 redraw triggers; the only map whose grid is not fixed, distinct in kind from every prior map, whose terrain is static.
designer_notes.witness_setup: No witness, no hall, no ledger left to write: this battle CANNOT be Sung and there is no True account that survives either, because there is no after (C-FRAME-03/04) — hence witness_rule always_unsung, not the standard C-ALIGN-04 rule. Salgerd (n1) stands at the last door with no escape_edge: she cannot leave and cannot be answered, the petition perverted rather than a preventable witness. The only 'witness' is the frame's own reveal — the skald is the harvest given a mouth, reciting on the last night of the world; what is chosen here ends the telling.
designer_notes.intent: SHOWCASE and the hidden Successor ending's battle (C-END-01): the seat taken from inside the thing eating the world; replaces ch4-06 on the secret path. Full-strength einherjar formations; the >=5 consumed are seated as the frame's audience. Reaching [8,8] sets final_choice=become_successor and the frame tears fully open.
